services.name: Lake Travis Boat Rental
services.desc: Two-story party boats on Lake Travis with water slides, SUP, lily pad, and premium sound. Multiple sizes from 15-25 guests. Take your Lake Travis experience to the next level - literally - with our Double Decker party boats. These two-story vessels are purpose-built for groups that want the ultimate on-the-water party. The upper deck gives you panoramic views of the lake and surrounding Hill Country, while the lower deck provides shaded seating, easy water access, and plenty of room to spread out. services.desc: Cruise Lake Travis in style with our luxury 2021 Bentley pontoon boat rentals. 13 guests + captain. Our 2021 Bentley pontoon is one of the most versatile boats in the Keep Austin Wet fleet. Built on a tritoon hull with a 150-horsepower engine, this luxury pontoon delivers a smooth, stable ride that makes it an ideal choice for families, smaller groups, and anyone looking for a relaxed day cruising Lake Travis. With comfortable seating for up to 13 guests plus your professional captain, it strikes the perfect balance between an intimate gathering and a full day of fun on the water.
